title: Don't see a direct fit?
description:
Don’t see a direct fit?

Axoft is always looking for talents to join us in the exciting journey of developing the next generation of bioinspired neural interface platform. We will need talents in the following fields:

  • Business Development (Corporate strategy, Marketing, Sales, Partner relationship)

  • Product Development (Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance)

  • Business Operation (Administration, HR)

  • Implant Development (Material Science, Microfabrication, Manufacturing)

  • Electronics Development (Electrical Engineering, IC Design, Embedded System Design)

  • Clinical Development (Robotics, Animal Surgery, Optical Imaging, Biocompatibility)

  • Software Development (Data Analysis, Machine Learning, UI/UX Design)

If you don’t see a direct fit on the current job postings but are still interested in joining us, please leave your contact information and CV here and we’ll contact you in the future when opportunity arises. Thank you!
